raw_text: USN: Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi. Third Semester B.E. Degree Examination, Jan/Feb 2023. Course Code: BCS304. Data Structures and Applications. Time: 3 Hours. Max. Marks: 100. Note: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing ONE full question from each module.

questions.text: Explain linear and non-linear data structures with examples. Distinguish between static and dynamic memory allocation.
Define recursion. Write a C program to solve the Tower of Hanoi problem with recursive trace.
Define stack. Explain push, pop, display operations with array implementation and boundary conditions.
Explain conversion of infix expression to postfix expression and evaluate the postfix expression using stack.
What is a singly linked list? Write functions to insert a node at the front, delete a node from the end, and reverse a singly linked list.
Explain doubly linked list with node structure. Write C algorithms to insert a node to the left of a target key and delete a node from the doubly linked list.
Define binary tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder). Construct a binary tree given Inorder and Preorder traversals.
Define Binary Search Tree (BST). Write algorithms to insert, search, and delete an element in a binary search tree.
Explain Depth First Search (DFS) and Breadth First Search (BFS) graph traversal algorithms with adjacency matrix/list and examples.
What is hashing? Explain collision resolution techniques: open addressing (linear probing, quadratic probing) and separate chaining with examples.

raw_text: USN: Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi. Fifth Semester B.E. Degree Examination, Jan/Feb 2023. Course Code: 21CS52. Computer Networks and Security. Time: 3 Hours. Max. Marks: 100. Note: Answer any FIVE full questions, choosing ONE full question from each module.

questions.text: Explain the OSI 7-layer reference model and compare it with the TCP/IP protocol suite.
Explain packet switching vs circuit switching and calculate transmission delay, propagation delay, queuing delay, and processing delay.
Explain HTTP protocol. Compare persistent and non-persistent HTTP connections with RTT diagrams.
Explain Domain Name System (DNS). Describe recursive and iterative DNS query resolution.
Explain TCP 3-way handshake connection establishment and connection teardown with state diagrams.
Explain TCP Congestion Control mechanism: Slow Start, Additive Increase Multiplicative Decrease (AIMD), and Fast Recovery.
Explain Distance Vector Routing algorithm using Bellman-Ford equation. Explain the Count-to-Infinity problem and its solutions.
Explain Link State Routing algorithm and apply Dijkstra's algorithm to find the shortest path from a given source node.
Explain RSA public-key cryptosystem. Generate keys and encrypt/decrypt a message given prime numbers p, q, and e.
Explain Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange algorithm with a numerical example and explain Man-in-the-Middle attack.
